answer: The stake is not a fee but a hostage: 75 POA per identity, released only after 13 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 260 fakes must lock 19500 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. Without lantern the panel is blind, without violet the farm is free, and without canyon nobody can prove what happened.
